name: WMA
description: This keyword returns the weighted moving average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the weighted moving average of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632220032.png)

You can plot WMA on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot WMA of RSI, OPEN etc

Weighted moving averages assign a heavier weighting to more current data points since they are more relevant than data points in the distant past.

Read more about WMA here -  https://www.fidelity.com/learning-center/trading-investing/technical-analysis/technical-indicator-guide/wma
